messages:
sophia: handing off to @raj for the overnight window — deploy scheduled 02:00 UTC (canary -> gradual rollout). low-risk but FYI: online index add on analytics.events, might bump write p95 by ~5-10% for ~10-15m. freeze window 01:30-03:30 UTC, please NO non-critical deploys :no_bell:

raj: acked. i'll be primary watcher. i'll open prod canary monitor and post status updates here. anyone volunteering as secondary watcher? :raising_hand:

deploy-bot: oncall coverage change: previous=sophia new=raj at 2026-11-02T01:45:00Z

luis: quick q — what's the canary ramp schedule? and is the index creation concurrent with canary?

sophia: canary ramp plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (30m per step, so ~90m total). index create runs before the canary but online background create so should be fine. we'll monitor write latency and the migration cursor.

emily: i'll join as secondary watcher, can take the 02:30-03:30 slot. ping me if the canary stalls.

alex: small prod check — ensure feature flag is off for non-test tenants. quick curl to verify health and flag state:

```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROD_MONITOR_TOKEN"
  https://api.redwood-inference.prod/internal/health | jq .flags.routing_opt_in
```

alex: if that returns false, good to go. if true, hold the rollout and flip off.

raj: got it. i'll run the health/flag check before starting canary. i'll also apply the rollback step in runbook if needed:

```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/api api=registry.redwood/infra-api:stable-3.0.9
# disable new feature flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  https://console.internal/flags/routing_opt_in -d '{"value":false}'
```

raj: i'm adding @emily and @alex as watchers in the console now and will post canary progress every 15m.

sophia: couple final notes — watch for increased DB write latency alert (alert id: DB.WRITE.LAT.P95). if it breaches 20% above baseline for >5m, pause rollout and engage infra-sre. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prod-deploys (see section "index-online-create").

emily: thanks — i'll take logs and metrics, call out any anomalies.

alex: typing up a tiny CR follow-up, ping me for a quick review pre-rollback.

raj: all set, taking over now. will update at 02:05 UTC when canary starts.
